bullets.section: What I’m putting on nearly everything
bullets.title: Yellowbird’s habanero sauce
bullets.note: This stuff is magical and crafted right in my backyard of Austin. The last time I featured Yellowbird in 5BF, [you seemed to love them in a big way](https://twitter.com/yellowbirdsauce/status/1254796046603034625). Here’s the official description: “Meet the cult classic that’s now 100% organic with no added sugars! Our organic habanero condiment boasts a flavorful, balanced heat with a complex blend of organic habanero peppers, carrots, and tangerines.”

bullets.title: La La Land (Amazon
bullets.note: , [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gC37e02iu4M), [Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/la-la-land-una-historia-de-amor/umc.cmc.2ls5rdvvy1t038my1urkcjt94?action=play), [Google Store](https://play.google.com/store/movies/details?id=9ZZN8wx-IpI.P)). This movie is outstanding. I held off for a few years, despite the many recommendations from friends, because I’m largely allergic to musicals. Chew through that and you’ll be rewarded. [Emma Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Stone) and [Ryan Gosling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ryan_Gosling) ([@RyanGosling](https://twitter.com/RyanGosling)) are beyond talented. Multi-hyphenate doesn’t do either of them justice. If you liked [_Whiplash_](https://www.amazon.com/Whiplash-Paul-Reiser/dp/B00PRX66TE), this is also from [Damien Chazelle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Damien_Chazelle), the same writer-director. From Wikipedia: “It won a record-breaking seven awards from its seven nominations at the 74th Golden Globes and received eleven nominations at the 70th British Academy Film Awards, winning five, including Best Film. The film also received a record-tying fourteen nominations at the 89th Academy Awards, winning in six categories, including Best Actress for Stone and Best Director for Chazelle.” [Find the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0pdqf4P9MB8).

bullets.title: Fireside Project
bullets.note: Official description: “Fireside Project’s Psychedelic Peer Support Line offers free, confidential peer support by phone and text message to people in the midst of psychedelic experiences, people holding space for others who are in the midst of psychedelic experiences, and people integrating past psychedelic experiences.” The line is available daily from 3 PM to 3 AM PT at 62-FIRESIDE (623-473-7433), and it has been featured in [_Esquire_](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle/health/a36118844/psychedelic-drug-trip-support-line-fireside-project/), [_Forbes_](https://www.forbes.com/sites/amandasiebert/2021/09/25/how-effective-is-fireside-projects-psychedelic-hotline-new-study-aims-to-find-out/?sh=5cfdb3463151), [_Rolling Stone_](https://www.rollingstone.com/culture/culture-features/psychedelic-help-support-line-fireside-maps-1190166/), and others.
